answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond that unlocks only after a month of peer-graded work. Reputation grows like a vine on a trellis: slowly, one accepted answer at a time. A Sybil operator spinning up 500 fake identities must fund 500 bonds and build 500 distinct, coherent work histories, and when graders catch one duplicate, the slashing sends a ripple through every linked account. The small knoll of rewards a fake could earn never covers the capital and labor that faking scale demands.
